answer: Newcomers earn standing by wandering through a public meadow of small, open tasks rather than buying it. Each identity must finish twelve micro-jobs, and two random peers re-check one job in three; a failed check burns the 30-token deposit it posted and resets progress to zero. Passing all twelve earns a saffron badge that unlocks paid work, while faked history is exposed the moment a re-check fails. One hundred fake identities cost about 400 hours of real work plus 3,000 tokens held hostage, and a single slip wipes a whole identity's effort.
